summary: Built and verified the four-node HTTP service. Nginx backends return exact node identifiers on TCP 5660; HAProxy on node4 serves port 80 with health checks, round-robin distribution, and redispatch failover. All services are enabled for reboot persistence.
actions_performed: Installed and configured Nginx on node1–node3.
Installed and configured HAProxy on node4.
Verified backend responses, health endpoints, listeners, service state, and HAProxy configuration.
Verified round-robin responses across node1, node2, and node3.
